zara: Quick intro thread 1- please welcome Anya Patel who starts today on Product as a PM! :tada:
anya patel: hi everyone! excited to join. tiny question already 1- I tried to access the product roadmap doc and got a 403. who handles doc perms?
leo: welcome @anya! usually that's the product docs group ACL. @marta can grant access if you give your work email.
marta: added you to the "product-docs" group, you should have access in 5-10 min. ping if not.
anya patel: I see it now, thanks @marta. also, is there a preferred laptop preference form? I put "macbook" but need GPU for occasional local testing.
ryan: hey @anya we typically give Macs for PMs; if you need GPU we set up a remote dev instance. file a ticket in #help with "remote-gpu" and we'll provision.
onboarding-bot: New hire checklist: "Anya Patel" added to Slack, Google Workspace, Notion, and calendar. Outstanding: badge pickup, 2FA, GitHub org invite.
anza: (note: this is a bot test message)
zara: @anya plan to meet the PM tribe at 4pm PT for intros. Also, fun fact for the team board: do you have one?
anya patel: fun fact: I bake sourdough and once taught a swap meet class on starters. :bread:
leo: love that. baking club meetups incoming. welcome aboard @anya! :wave:
